name: pasture
description: Every pull request on your team is a cow. Watch them move from pen to pen as they get reviewed, fixed and merged.

scripts.media: node scripts/media/record-hand-of-god.mjs docs/media/hand-of-god.webm && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -ss 3.5 -i docs/media/hand-of-god.webm -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 25 -r 30 -movflags +faststart docs/media/hand-of-god.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -ss 3.5 -t 11 -i docs/media/hand-of-god.webm -vf "fps=10,scale=720:-1:flags=lanczos,split[a][b];[a]palettegen=max_colors=96[p];[b][p]paletteuse=dither=bayer:bayer_scale=5" docs/media/hand-of-god.gif
